title: Tighten the engram-use first-import, memory-read and memory opt-in wording found in the sync-rule review
outcome: Tighten the engram-use first-import, memory-read and memory opt-in wording found in the sync-rule review
acceptance: The skill and git-task-sync.md say a store's first import after its own export (for example the first publisher's) uses --basis, and an empty joining store uses --empty-basis
The skill's import step describes what an incremental import reads (the task delta plus re-read held or locally published tasks) and that selected memory histories are read separately
The first-memory-opt-in guidance links to the ignore-policy allowlist procedure in git-task-sync.md (memory_ignore_policy_excludes_tree), and no longer compares the opt-in to a note-selection change
